description: Marketing, Product launch, Business strategy, Customer communication, Brand promotion

questions.badPrompt: How can a company increase sales?
questions.context: A direct-to-consumer organic skincare brand experiencing slowing quarterly revenue growth.
missingElements: Business model & unit economics (AOV, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate)
Specific growth channels (omnichannel retail, influencer affiliate loops, email upsells)
Budget constraints, timeline milestones, and expected revenue targets
Structured strategic framework (e.g., Ansoff Matrix, Pirate Funnel AAARRR)
Output format (executive memo with prioritized action items)

questions.badPrompt: Sell this product.
questions.context: A premium noise-cancelling smart headphone designed for software developers & remote workers.
missingElements: Product details and unique selling proposition (USP)
Ideal customer profile (ICP) and acoustic pain points
Marketing copywriting framework (AIDA or PAS)
Pricing tier, objection handling, and conversion CTA
Delivery format (landing page copy, cold email, sales deck)

questions.badPrompt: Write a launch strategy for an app.
questions.context: A peer-to-peer campus ride-sharing and carpool app.
missingElements: Target geography and rollout phases (Closed Beta vs Campus Blitz)
User acquisition channels (guerrilla marketing, campus ambassadors)
Budget constraints and 30-day timeline breakdown
Key performance indicators (CAC, LTV, Daily Active Riders)

questions.badPrompt: Write an email to win back churning customers.
questions.context: A B2B SaaS analytics platform addressing canceled pro-tier accounts.
missingElements: Customer segmentation (usage drop vs pricing friction)
Empathetic, non-defensive executive tone
Specific value-reinforcement and feature update highlights
Tailored discount/extension incentive with a frictionless 1-click reactivation link

questions.badPrompt: Create a pitch deck script for investors.
questions.context: An early-stage climate-tech startup seeking $1.5M Seed funding for solar recycling tech.
missingElements: Standard 10-slide venture narrative structure (Problem, TAM, Solution, Unit Economics, Moat)
Explicit financial traction metrics and IP patents
Direct competitor matrix with unfair advantage
Specific capital allocation breakdown (R&D vs Commercialization)

questions.badPrompt: How should we price our new subscription service?
questions.context: An AI-powered video editing tool transitioning from free beta to paid monetization tiers.
missingElements: Pricing strategy model (Freemium, Usage-based, Value-based tiers: Starter/Pro/Enterprise)
Feature gating matrix (export resolution, cloud rendering minutes, team seats)
Competitor price benchmarking and willingness-to-pay elasticity
Annual vs monthly billing discount incentives

questions.badPrompt: Write a partnership proposal to a major brand.
questions.context: A student esports tournament platform proposing co-branding to a global gaming beverage company.
missingElements: Mutual value proposition and audience alignment metrics (Gen Z gamer reach, stream impressions)
Tiered sponsorship packages (Title Sponsor, Official Energy Partner) with deliverables
Activation ideas (custom branded tournaments, influencer shoutouts, booth space)
Investment pricing and clear meeting scheduling call to action

questions.badPrompt: Create a go-to-market plan for an electric delivery bike.
questions.context: B2B commercial launch targeting last-mile grocery delivery fleets in tier-1 metro cities.
missingElements: B2B buyer persona (Fleet Managers, Logistics Heads, Unit Franchisees)
Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) comparison against petrol scooters
Direct sales & pilot trial deployment strategy
After-sales battery swapping SLA and servicing guarantees

questions.badPrompt: Write a crisis communication response for a data leak.
questions.context: A fintech digital wallet app acknowledging an unauthorized database exposure affecting 50,000 users.
missingElements: Official executive transparency tone (no legalistic obfuscation)
Clear disclosure of what was exposed vs what remained encrypted (passwords/funds safe)
Immediate remedial actions taken (patch deployment, law enforcement notification)
User action steps (2FA reset, free credit monitoring helpline)

questions.badPrompt: How do we hire top software engineers on a startup budget?
questions.context: A seed-funded AI startup competing with big tech compensation in a tight engineering talent market.
missingElements: Employee Value Proposition (EVP) focusing on equity upside, autonomy, and rapid tech stack ownership
Alternative sourcing channels (open-source contributors, hackathons, niche Discord communities)
Streamlined, respectful technical interview workflow (take-home vs pair programming)
Non-monetary perks (fully remote, asynchronous culture, learning stipends)

questions.badPrompt: Write a cold outreach message to prospective clients on LinkedIn.
questions.context: A cybersecurity consultancy reaching out to CISOs of mid-market healthcare providers.
missingElements: Hyper-personalized opening hook referencing recent industry compliance mandates (HIPAA audit)
Clear pain-point trigger (ransomware vulnerabilities in legacy hospital portals)
Zero-obligation low-friction offer (Free 15-minute attack surface vulnerability scan)
Concise length under 100 words with polite sign-off

questions.badPrompt: Conduct a SWOT analysis for a boutique coffee chain.
questions.context: A regional 10-store specialty coffee roaster considering expansion into airport terminals.
missingElements: Structured 2x2 SWOT grid format with 4-5 high-signal bullet points per quadrant
Specific external factors (airport foot traffic, high concession fees, drive-thru competition)
Internal capabilities (direct-trade bean supply chain vs limited capital reserves)
Synthesis section with SO, ST, WO, WT actionable strategic plays

questions.badPrompt: Write an executive summary for our annual business review.
questions.context: A cloud logistics SaaS summarizing fiscal year performance for board stakeholders.
missingElements: Key top-line financial metrics (ARR growth, Net Revenue Retention, Gross Margin, Burn Multiple)
Major product milestones shipped and enterprise client logo acquisitions
Macro headwinds, competitive threats, and operational bottlenecks encountered
3 strategic north-star bets for the upcoming fiscal year

questions.badPrompt: How can we expand our brand internationally?
questions.context: A direct-to-consumer Indian organic tea brand entering the UK and European retail market.
missingElements: Market entry mode evaluation (Direct export, E-commerce cross-border, Local distributor joint venture)
Regulatory & certification compliance (EU Organic, Fairtrade import duties, packaging regulations)
Localization strategy (flavour preferences, premium gifting packaging adaptation)
Phased 12-month budget and milestone roadmap

questions.badPrompt: Design a customer loyalty reward program.
questions.context: A fast-casual healthy salad bowl restaurant chain with 25 physical outlets.
missingElements: Program structure (Tiered status vs Points-per-dollar vs Subscription VIP club)
Reward catalog economics (high perceived value with low marginal cost food perks)
Gamification & retention triggers (streak bonuses, birthday surprises, double-point Tuesdays)
Mobile app integration and pos cashier frictionless onboarding mechanism

questions.badPrompt: Write a script for firing an agency for poor performance.
questions.context: A VP of Marketing terminating a digital performance ad agency due to missed ROAS targets over 3 quarters.
missingElements: Professional, firm, and legally sound executive tone
Documented chronological performance discrepancies against agreed SLA contract terms
Smooth transition and asset handover timeline (ad accounts, creative assets, remaining invoices)
Clear 30-day formal termination date

questions.badPrompt: Create a competitor battlecard for sales reps.
questions.context: A modern project management tool competing directly against legacy Jira in enterprise sales deals.
missingElements: Quick-reference battlecard structure (Competitor Strengths, Weaknesses, Landmines to Lay)
Objection-handling soundbites for common buyer hesitations ('Jira is already integrated')
Feature-by-feature side-by-side differentiation table (Speed, UI simplicity, AI auto-summaries)
Pricing & total cost of ownership knockout argument

questions.badPrompt: How can a retail store deal with showrooming?
questions.context: A brick-and-mortar consumer electronics store where shoppers test gear in person but buy cheaper on Amazon.
missingElements: In-store unique value creation (instant price matching, extended in-house warranty, trade-in bonus)
Staff training to pivot showroomers into consultative experience-based buyers
Bundling strategies (free setup, local repair guarantees, exclusive distributor package deals)
Omnichannel retail app integration with exclusive in-store checkout discounts

questions.badPrompt: Write a performance improvement plan for an underperforming employee.
questions.context: A constructive PIP for an account executive missing quarterly sales quotas for two consecutive periods.
missingElements: Empathetic, clear, and objective HR-compliant documentation
Specific quantitative activity & output benchmarks (Outreach calls/week, Demo completion rate, Closed revenue)
Support resources provided (weekly 1-on-1 coaching, pitch training, shadowing top performers)
30/60/90-day review cadence and explicit success criteria

questions.badPrompt: Write an RFP for selecting a new cloud vendor.
questions.context: An enterprise financial institution seeking Request For Proposal bids for multi-cloud infrastructure migration.
missingElements: Technical scope of work (compute workloads, latency SLAs, zero-trust security standards, DR redundancy)
Vendor qualification criteria and compliance mandates (SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR)
Pricing model breakdown (reserved instances, egress cost caps, support tiers)
Submission timeline, scoring rubric, and procurement evaluation phases

questions.badPrompt: Create a viral referral program for a fintech app.
questions.context: A student neo-banking app wanting to acquire 100,000 university users with zero ad spend.
missingElements: Double-sided viral incentive mechanics (Give ₹100, Get ₹100 upon first campus debit transaction)
Gamified milestone unlocks (Unlock custom metal card at 5 successful friends invited)
Anti-fraud and identity verification verification safeguards (Aadhaar/PAN KYC check before reward disbursement)
Frictionless sharing flow (WhatsApp deep-links, instant QR code campus tap)

questions.badPrompt: How to pivot a failing restaurant into a cloud kitchen?
questions.context: A high-rent sit-down dining venue with plummeting foot traffic restructuring into a multi-brand virtual kitchen.
missingElements: Operational transition roadmap (kitchen line reconfiguration, packaging optimization for 30-minute delivery transit)
Multi-brand menu matrix (Biryani brand + Burger brand running on same kitchen inventory)
Aggregator negotiation & optimization strategy (Zomato/Swiggy ad bidding, commission margins)
Cost restructuring model (Front-of-house staff reallocation, rent renegotiation)

questions.badPrompt: Write a franchise expansion agreement proposal.
questions.context: A successful bubble tea brand pitching franchise opportunities to regional master franchise investors.
missingElements: Franchise fee structure (Initial franchise fee, 5% ongoing royalty, 2% national marketing fund)
Unit economics snapshot (Average payback period, EBITDA margin, capex per store)
Franchisor support package (Site selection, standard operating procedure manual, centralized syrup supply chain)
Territory exclusivity conditions and minimum store rollout schedule

questions.badPrompt: How to handle a sudden supplier price hike?
questions.context: A manufacturing company facing an unexpected 25% price increase on key raw metal components.
missingElements: Strategic negotiation playbook (Volume commitment leverage, contract clause review, payment term extension)
Alternative supplier qualification & dual-sourcing framework
Internal value engineering (Component redesign, scrap reduction)
Selective customer price pass-through strategy without triggering churn

questions.badPrompt: Write an all-hands speech announcing a company pivot.
questions.context: A CEO delivering a 10-minute town hall announcing a shift from custom software services to a standardized AI product.
missingElements: Visionary narrative framing (Honoring past achievements while explaining urgency of market shift)
Addressing employee anxiety (Job role transitions, upskilling programs, transparent runway updates)
Clear 90-day company-wide operational priorities and milestone expectations
Q&A session handling guidelines and inspiring closing call to action
